pages.text: Shadow Shift creates a two-way portal between one block ahead and the crosshair direction up to 30 blocks away, without requiring a block target. The portals last 30 seconds, use a 64 tick cooldown and cost 200 mana. Aftertaste Guard provides up to 40 extra damage absorption: tap to affect the crosshair target or hold for at least 10 ticks to affect yourself. It uses a 3000 tick cooldown, costs 1000 mana, and never heals. Ember Beam is a held continuous beam costing 20 mana every 5 ticks. Branch Link costs 300 mana to form a link and transfers 50% of the damage once without recursion. Dream Bind roots a target for 100 ticks at 250 mana while leaving turning and attacking available.
